description: Door unlock schedules; issuing and removing tenant and contractor credentials; reviewing door events and camera video after an incident
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Wrong or lost door control leaves the building open after hours or locks tenants out; credential changes are made about weekly, so a day of lost changes is tolerable; tenants' trust in building security
manual_workaround: Door controllers keep cached credentials and schedules offline; owner unlocks or locks entrances with mechanical keys and stands by during business hours if needed; egress is always free
dependent_third_parties: Access control vendor; camera vendor; installer; internet provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner (single point of failure; only administrator); building entrances

description: Cooling and heating schedules and setpoints for the 8 rooftop units through the smart thermostats; HVAC contractor dispatch
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Florida heat: the cafe and nail salon cannot open without cooling, and summer heat in closed suites can damage tenant goods; schedules rarely change
manual_workaround: Thermostats keep their last schedule offline and can be set at the wall; owner or HVAC contractor sets each thermostat by hand
dependent_third_parties: Thermostat platform vendor; HVAC contractor; internet provider

description: Tenant calls, emails, and portal maintenance requests; urgent repairs (leaks, power, locks); building notices
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Urgent repairs must be dispatched the same day; tenants expect a reply within one business day
manual_workaround: Owner's phone number posted in the lobby; calls and texts from the phone; printed contractor list
dependent_third_parties: Email and file provider; property management SaaS vendor; phone carrier; contractors

description: Monthly ACH rent through the tenant portal; checks; expense recoveries; paying contractors and the mortgage
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $15,000 of rent is due on the 1st with a 5-day grace period in the leases; the mortgage and property tax are paid from the same account; a week of delay is survivable
manual_workaround: Tenants pay by check; owner records payments when the system returns; personal savings cover about one month of expenses
dependent_third_parties: Property management SaaS vendor and its payment partner; bank; outside CPA

description: Lease files, guarantor documents, credit reports, insurance certificates, contractor agreements; marketing vacant space
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Leasing decisions take weeks; records are rarely needed on short notice; RPO of 24 hours is not supported today because files and the laptop have no backup
manual_workaround: Signed paper leases in the home-office cabinet; copies in the property management SaaS
dependent_third_parties: Email and file provider; tenant screening service; real estate attorney
